raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector, rolling out since 2026-01-17, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy and the pipeline use America/Chicago local time. Evening Chicago v2 transactions on 2026-01-18 therefore land at 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-19, and the sample v2 row at 12:11 UTC is 06:11 CST. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_ts and txn_date fixes silver and all downstream gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH src AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM src WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
